method: static reading only; no vendor code executed
findings: COMPX ko.setMacro is at 2115264; generic earlier setMacro overloads belong to other protocol families and are not used as mouse evidence.
Recorder creates a positive magnitude, direction state2 Up or3 Down.
COMPX writer ignores magnitude and emits exactly one direction row (value1=1 Up,255 Down), then one neutral row (value1=0). Both rows use f(k.delay,S).
Pinned sensor map is empty: normalized delay is at least1ms for both rows, including the last source event.

getMacro separately exports each native row: Up uses negative keyCode; neutral0 is labeled Up. These readback entries cannot be fed back into the typed recorder importer without ambiguity or double expansion.
Importer admits only positive recorder magnitude and explicit wheel direction; zero/negative, down/up key states and nonintegral magnitudes refuse whole selected button import.
limits: No physical OEM export or playback evidence
Only retained pinned COMPX implementation, not all ATK families
Raw readback neutral coalescing remains unimplemented
